paite: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: Kuapeuh in thil hihkhial in, TOUPA thu tatleek khum taleh, sum kepsak thu ah hiam, leep thu ah hiam, guktaak thu ah hiam a innsak-innkhangte khem in, a innsak-innkhangte zuaubawl taleh,
english: “If anyone sins, and commits a trespass against Yahweh, and deals falsely with his neighbor in a matter of deposit, or of bargain, or of robbery, or has oppressed his neighbor,

paite: Ahihkei leh, van mangte mu in, khem in, zuau in kichiam leh, hiai thil tengteng a bangmah leng a hihkhelh leh,
english: or has found that which was lost, and dealt falsely therein, and swearing to a lie; in any of all these things that a man does, sinning therein;

paite: Hichi ahi ding a, a khial ngei a hih a, siamlouh a tan leh a vangukte, khem a a thil lakte, a kiang a sum kepsakte, van mang a topte,
english: then it shall be, if he has sinned, and is guilty, he shall restore that which he took by robbery, or the thing which he has gotten by oppression, or the deposit which was committed to him, or the lost thing which he found,

paite: Zuau a a kichiamna thil bangpeuh leng a ditnawn ding ahi; a kim sipsip in a din nawn vek ding a, a mun nga a khen a mun khat a val in a behlap ding: siamlouh a tan ni in, a neitu a pe ding ahi.
english: or any thing about which he has sworn falsely; he shall restore it even in full, and shall add a fifth part more to it. To him to whom it belongs he shall give it, in the day of his being found guilty.

paite: A tatleek thoihna, belam hon lak a, na ngaih a kilawm hun, belampa gensiatbei tatleek thoihna ding in TOUPA ding in siampu kiang ah a honkai ding ahi:
english: He shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh, a ram without blemish from the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest.

paite: Huan, siampu in TOUPA ma ah kilepna a bawlsak ding a, ngaihdam ahi ding, siamlouh tanna ding a thil a hih peuhmah tungthu ahte, chi in.
english: The priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh, and he will be forgiven concerning whatever he does to become guilty.”

paite: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: Aron leh a tapate kiang ah, Hiai haltum thillat dan ding ahi: haltum thillat pen maitam tung a a halna ah zankhua in a zingchiang tan in a om ding a; huan, maitam a mei pen a am nilouh ding ahi.
english: “Command Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the burnt offering: the burnt offering shall be on the hearth on the altar all night until the morning; and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it.

paite: Huan, siampu in a puanmalngat puansilh a silh ding a, a sa khuhna ding in a puan malngat khekol a teng ding a; huan, maitam a haltum thillat kang vute a la ding a, maitam pang ah a koih ding ahi.
english: The priest shall put on his linen garment, and he shall put on his linen breeches upon his body; and he shall remove the ashes from where the fire has consumed the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.

paite: Huan, a puansilh siangthou a suah ding a, puansilh dang a silh ding a, a vute dainawl lam mun siang ah a paipih ding ahi.
english: He shall take off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.

paite: Huan, maitam tung a mei ap sak nilouh ahi ding a, a mit ding ahi kei; huan, siampu in zingsang teng in sing a khul ding a, haltum thillat a koih hoih ding a, huai ah lepna thillatte thau a hal ding ahi.
english: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it, it shall not go out; and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning: and he shall lay the burnt offering in order upon it, and shall burn on it the fat of the peace offerings.

paite: Maitam ah mei a am gige ding a, a mit ding ahi kei.
english: Fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually; it shall not go out.

paite: Huan, hiai hi tangbuang thillat dan ding ahi: Aron tapate'n maitam bul ah, TOUPA ma ah a lat ding uh ahi.
english: “‘This is the law of the meal offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before Yahweh, before the altar.

paite: Huan, aman a pham khat in tangbuang thillat tung a begaw tengteng a lakhe ding a, huaibel TOUPA ding a gimlim tak, theih gigena ding in maitam ah a hal ding ahi.
english: He shall take from there his handful of the fine flour of the meal offering, and of its oil, and all the frankincense which is on the meal offering, and shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma, as its memorial, to Yahweh.

paite: Huan, lak bangte Aron leh a tapate'n a nek ding uh ahi: huaibel mun siangthou ah silngou soh louh in a ne ding ua; kihoupihna puan inn kongtual ah a ne ding uh ahi.
english: That which is left of it Aaron and his sons shall eat. It shall be eaten without yeast in a holy place. They shall eat it in the court of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Silngou soh a kan ding ahi kei. Mei a ka thillat a a tantuan ding ua ka piak ahi; huaibel khelh thoihna leh tatleek thoihna bang a thil siangthou tak ahi.
english: It shall not be baked with yeast. I have given it as their portion of my offerings made by fire. It is most holy, as the sin offering, and as the trespass offering.

paite: Aron suan pasal tengteng in a nek ding uh ahi. Huaibel TOUPA a dia haltum thillat tungthu a na suante zel uh tan a khantawn dan ahi ding: kuapeuh huaite khoih peuhmah hihtuam ahi ding uh, chi in thu pia in, chi in.
english: Every male among the children of Aaron shall eat of it, as their portion forever throughout your generations, from the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. Whoever touches them shall be holy.’”

paite: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: Sathau nilh a a om ni a Aron leh a tapate'n TOUPA kiang a a lat ding uh thillat pen hiai ahi; tangbuang thillat dia lat zel ding, tangbuang nel dimdem epha sawm a khen a mun khat, zingsang in a kim, nitak in a kim.
english: “This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer to Yahweh in the day when he is anointed: the tenth part of an ephah 1 ephah is about 22 litres or about 2/3 of a bushel of fine flour for a meal offering perpetually, half of it in the morning, and half of it in the evening.

paite: A kidiah suak khit chiang in na hon la lut ding a: a kitam nengneng in tangbuang thillat TOUPA a ding in gimlim di'n na lan ding ahi.
english: It shall be made with oil in a griddle. When it is soaked, you shall bring it in. You shall offer the meal offering in baked pieces for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: A tapate lak a a sik a pangmi, sathau nilh siampu in a lan ding a: khantawn dan ding bang in TOUPA a di'n haltum vek ahi ding ahi.
english: The anointed priest that will be in his place from among his sons shall offer it. By a statute forever, it shall be wholly burnt to Yahweh.

paite: Siampu tangbuang thillat peuhmah haltum vek ding ahi a, nek hetlouh ding ahi, chi in.
english: Every meal offering of a priest shall be wholly burned. It shall not be eaten.”

paite: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: Hiai hi khelh thoihna dan ding ahi: haltum thillat goh zelna ah khelh thoihna leng TOUPA ma a goh ding ahi: huaibel thil siangthou tak ahi.
english: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the sin offering: in the place where the burnt offering is killed, the sin offering shall be killed before Yahweh. It is most holy.

paite: Khelh thoihna lantu siampu in a ne ding a; kihoupihna puan in kongtual ah, mun siangthou ah nek ding ahi.
english: The priest who offers it for sin shall eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place, in the court of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Kuapeuh huai sa khoih peuhmah a siangthou ding uh: huan, a sisan in pen bangpuan peuh leng a theh leh, a banna peuhmah mun siangthou ah na sawp ding ahi.
english: Whatever shall touch its flesh shall be holy. When there is any of its blood sprinkled on a garment, you shall wash that on which it was sprinkled in a holy place.

paite: A huanna leibel pen sukkhap ding ahi: sum bel a huan a hih lebel nawt siang a khuah siang ding ahi.
english: But the earthen vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken; and if it is boiled in a bronze vessel, it shall be scoured, and rinsed in water.

paite: Pasal siampu tengteng in huai a ne ding uh ahi: huaibel thil siangthou tak ahi.Khelh thoihna, a sisan, mun siangthou a kilepna bawlna ding a kihoupihna puan inn a hong kitawi pen nek ding ahi kei hi: mei a haltum ding ahi.
english: Every male among the priests shall eat of it: it is most holy.

paite: Khelh thoihna, a sisan, mun siangthou a kilepna bawlna ding a kihoupihna puan inn a hong kitawi pen nek ding ahi kei hi: mei a haltum ding ahi.
english: No sin offering, of which any of the blood is brought into the Tent of Meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be eaten: it shall be burned with fire.
